name: Moodle-to-Vektra Ingestion — mooc.unical.it
comment: Second Moodle. Reads MOOC_MOODLE_URL, MOOC_MOODLE_WS_TOKEN and MOOC_STATE_FILE_PATH: n8n env is per-process, so two workflows in one n8n need distinct names. MOOC_STATE_FILE_PATH must point at the file this instance already uses, /home/node/.n8n/moodle-ingest-state-mooc.json, or its whole index is re-ingested.
